user.title: Rain radar
user.description:
Pick the point to watch (it starts from the home location set in Home Assistant). Radar data comes from the Italian Civil Protection (Radar-DPC) every 5 minutes, with RainViewer as fallback outside Italy.

{avviso}

error.posizione_predefinita: This is Home Assistant's default location, not a real one: move the point on the map or set the home location in Settings → System → General.

data_description.raggio: How many km around the point to analyse (20–150).
data_description.preavviso: "Rain incoming" turns on when the estimated arrival is within this many minutes.
